WITH matched_records AS (
  SELECT 
    o.timespan,
    COUNT(*) as record_count
  FROM riskandmargin r
  JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.timespan
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(record_count) as total_count,
    COUNT(*) as timespan_count
  FROM matched_records
)
SELECT 
  m.timespan,
  m.record_count,
  CAST(m.record_count AS FLOAT) / t.total_count as share,
  (CAST(m.record_count AS FLOAT) / t.total_count) - (1.0 / t.timespan_count) as difference_from_avg
FROM matched_records m
CROSS JOIN totals t
ORDER BY m.timespan
